issue_context.title: Select Stmt return slowly during retrieving metadata inside TiDB in some edge cases
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

1.1 Deploy a cluster like the yaml file. Ensure that the tidb server and the tikv server are in different machines.

```
pd_servers:
        - host: 10.6.6.1
          name: pd

tidb_servers:
        - host: 10.6.6.1

tikv_servers:
        - host: 10.6.6.2

```

1.2 Then use iptables to cut the port for tikv_server( in the 10.6.6.2 machine):
``` 
iptables -I INPUT -s 10.6.6.2 -ptcp --dport 20180 -j DROP
```

1.3 Connect to the TiDB server and send the query:
```
mysql> select * from information_schema.cluster_config;
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

Return quickly, like 5 or 10 seconds with a warning.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

Usually, this would cause 2 minutes of waiting. 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29370032/184604912-e0de3ce4-cf80-4ef6-87e0-cf9645f437d8.png)

In some case, it may be much longer:
```
mysql> show processlist;
+------+------+----------------+------+---------+------+------------+-------------------------------------------------+
| Id   | User | Host           | db   | Command | Time | State      | Info
                  |
+------+------+----------------+------+---------+------+------------+-------------------------------------------------+
|    7 | root | 10.6.6.1:36000 | NULL | Query   |  488 | autocommit | select * from information_schema.cluster_config |
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

v5.2.1 and can be reproduced in the master.

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
comments:
The reason is that inside TiDB it fetches some metadata from different instance by using HTTP request called `InternalHTTPClient` but does not set the timeout. Thus it may take a long time to return if encounter failure. In some edge cases, if the dst instance is hanging, it may be an endless selection.


And usually, many other operations would be affected, at least including:
1. cut the TiFlash port and select the `TIFLASH_TABLES`, `TIFLASH_SEGMENTS`, `TIFLASH_REPLICA` in `INFORMATION_SCHEMA`
2. cut the PD port and select the `CLUSTER_INFO` in `INFORMATION_SCHEMA`.
